spans.s: Nadin, n. of a brahman: nadī nāma Mv 〔iii.325.2〕. The same personage is referred to, but not named, in Pali, Vin. 〔i.2.32〕.

nadī-kāla(-samaya), time for the river, i.e. perhaps time for bathing in it (?): nadīkāla- (v.l. ˚kāle) samaye nadīye nairaṃjanāye snāyitvā Mv 〔i.4.5〕. Senart has no note. See s.v. nāga-nadī, Mv 〔ii.131.11〕.

Nadī-kāśyapa (= Pali Nadī-kassapa), n. of one of Buddhaʼs disciples, mentioned with his brothers Uruvilvākāśyapa and Gayā-k˚, qq.v.: Mv 〔iii.102.12〕; 〔103.2〕; 〔430.12, 18〕; 〔432.8〕; SP 〔2.1〕; 〔207.3〕; LV 〔1.11〕; Mvy 〔1050〕 (misprinted Nadi˚); Sukh 〔2.5〕.
Nadīdatta, n. of a Bodhisattva: Mvy 〔722〕; = Tib. chu bos byin, given by a river.
nāda, acc. to mss. for nāḍa = nāla, stalk (of a flower): padumehi … nīla-vaiḍūrya-nādehi Mv 〔ii.302.1〕 (prose), so mss.; Senart em. ˚nāḍīhi.
Nādikā (= Pali id., also Ñātikā), n. of a village: MPS 〔9.2 ff.〕
